raw_inputs.raw_text: I am deciding whether to continue with Option A, switch to Option B, or redesign the situation entirely. The situation has meaningful upside, but it also has repeated costs and uncertainty.

raw_input_parse.raw_input: I am deciding whether to continue with Option A, switch to Option B, or redesign the situation entirely. The situation has meaningful upside, but it also has repeated costs and uncertainty.

decision_candidate.plain_language_summary: The user is deciding whether to continue, stop, switch, or redesign a high-impact situation.

raw_input_parse.hidden_dilemma: The real dilemma is whether more time will create useful evidence or merely extend an already-disproven pattern.
constraints: Meaningful downside if the decision is mishandled
known_background: The situation has both upside and repeated costs
assumptions_to_test: A bounded test will create new evidence

execution_capacity_estimate.note: Capacity must be clarified before recommending a complex plan.

decision_importance_assessment.why: The decision affects future optionality, resource allocation, and repeated downstream choices.

better_questions: Is this situation still viable enough to deserve more time?
Would a bounded test create new evidence, or extend an already-disproven pattern?
clarification_needed: How many times has this pattern already repeated?
Who or what must change for the situation to improve?
What non-negotiables define whether continuing is acceptable?
What remaining value is still worth preserving?

user_summary.one_sentence_recommendation: Run a bounded viability test before committing, stopping, or redesigning.
user_summary.core_reason: More time is justified only if it can produce new evidence.
user_summary.biggest_risk_or_objection: A test can become disguised delay if standards are vague.

recommendation.short_answer: Run a bounded viability test only if the situation has no disqualifiers and can produce new evidence.
recommendation.core_reason: The situation has possible remaining value, but continued investment needs evidence.
recommendation.key_bet: A viable situation should produce observable signal within a bounded window.
recommendation.strongest_contrarian_objection: The test may simply extend an already-disproven pattern.
recommendation.response_to_contrarian: The test is valid only if disqualifiers are absent, standards are explicit, and the stop-loss is pre-defined.
change_log: Added a viability check before recommending any test plan.

viability_check.ownership_required: The required source of change must be named.
viability_check.note: This remains conditional until missing information is resolved.

recommended_action_plan.success_condition: The user can name what would make continuation unacceptable.

do_not_do: Do not continue on vague hope
Do not run a test without stop conditions
what_would_make_this_wrong: The situation already has decisive evidence
